# Fixture provenance

Every `.pdf` here is generated byte-exact by `tools/gen_fixtures.py` (run:
`python tools/gen_fixtures.py` from the crate root; Python 3.13.15, no
external PDF library writes the files). The generator emits three xref
shapes (classic table, xref stream, xref stream + `/ObjStm` object
streams), real RC4-40 V1/R2 Standard encryption for `encrypted.pdf`, and
fixed `/ID` with no timestamps so output is reproducible.

Expected `.txt` files are the canonical rendering of the generator's own
text operators under the extraction rules documented in `src/content.rs`
(line breaks on `Td`/`Tm`/`T*`/`'`/`"`, space on a `TJ` gap < -250 or a
horizontal step >= 250 text units, `\x0c` between pages). They are
hand-verifiable against the generators' operands and against the PDF
spec's own Annex-H shaped CMap examples.

Oracles used during generation (not required by the test suite):
- pypdf 6.13.3 — text equality on all unencrypted fixtures; on
  `encrypted.pdf` it decrypts (empty user password) and sees the same
  words, proving the crate's refusal is policy, not a parse failure.
- PyMuPDF 1.27 — cross-check only; where it disagrees with the spec
  (MacRoman `/MacRomanEncoding` table, ToUnicode on CID fonts, Tc-based
  word splitting) the spec/pypdf behaviour is authoritative.

## Divergences from MuPDF (documented, spec-backed)

- `standard_default.pdf`: StandardEncoding leaves byte 0xEF unmapped
  (`.notdef`); MuPDF renders it as `ï` via WinAnsi fallthrough. The
  extractor emits U+FFFD, matching the published StandardEncoding table.
- `cid_*.pdf`: MuPDF decodes Identity-H bytes as UTF-16BE instead of
  consulting `/ToUnicode`; the extractor requires ToUnicode per
  PDF 32000-1 §9.10.3 and refuses without it.
- `zapfdingbats.pdf`/`macroman.pdf`: MuPDF falls back to Latin-1/WinAnsi
  where the declared encoding table gives different code points.
- `markcontent.pdf`: MuPDF word-splits on `Tc` alone; the spec's text
  state makes `Tc` part of the character advance, and `TJ` gaps / `TD`
  leading carry the line structure.
